name: X-linked Intellectual Disability with Isolated Growth Hormone Deficiency
aliases: X-linked Mental Retardation with Growth Hormone Deficiency

criteria.description: Presence of intellectual disability confirmed by standardized cognitive testing
Biochemical evidence of isolated growth hormone deficiency without other pituitary hormone deficiencies
Family history consistent with X-linked inheritance pattern
Identification of pathogenic variant in gene associated with XLID and GH deficiency

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of intellectual disability and isolated growth hormone deficiency confirmed biochemically, plus identification of pathogenic variant or consistent family history
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other causes of intellectual disability and growth hormone deficiency.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Decreased response to growth hormone stimulation test

laboratory: Low serum IGF-1 and IGFBP-3 levels
Blunted GH response to stimulation tests
Normal levels of other pituitary hormones
imaging: Normal or hypoplastic pituitary gland on MRI
Delayed bone age on hand/wrist X-ray
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes linked to X-linked intellectual disability and GH deficiency (e.g., specific gene not yet fully characterized)
other: Family pedigree consistent with X-linked inheritance

distinguishingFeatures: Multiple pituitary hormone deficiencies rather than isolated GH deficiency
Intellectual disability without associated growth hormone deficiency
GH deficiency due to acquired causes (tumor, trauma) rather than genetic X-linked cause
May have other pituitary hormone deficiencies

redFlags: Severe intellectual disability with failure to thrive
Family history of affected males with similar phenotype
references: Orphanet: X-linked intellectual disability with isolated growth hormone deficiency - ORPHA:67045
Clinical Endocrinology Reviews, 2023; Genetic causes of isolated growth hormone deficiency
Journal of Medical Genetics, 2022; X-linked intellectual disability syndromes
